caption: heads-up: retrograde mars backs from virgo into leo on sunday, feb 21. find your sign.

slides.headline: *mars* backs into *leo* sunday at 9:15 am. *3 signs* feel it most
*mars* left leo on nov 25. now it looks like it's coming back
slides.body: mars turned retrograde at 10.4° virgo on jan 10. as earth keeps passing it, it appears to slide back across the line into leo, where jupiter is too.

rows.label: leo
rows.text: old drive returns. aim it, don't swing it.

rows.label: virgo
rows.text: mars leaves you. the pressure eases.

rows.label: taurus
rows.text: home stuff flares. pick one battle.

rows.label: scorpio
rows.text: work wants a redo, not a war.

rows.label: aries
rows.text: an old crush resurfaces. check why.

rows.label: sagittarius
rows.text: a trip or plan gets revisited.

rows.label: cancer
rows.text: money moves can wait a week.

rows.label: libra
rows.text: a friend needs you to show up.

rows.label: capricorn
rows.text: venus has your back. use it.

slides.headline: the fight isn't back. the *pattern* is.
slides.body: tag your leo. save this for sunday.
